title: Glowing snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground snow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#a8e6ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='17' fill='#e8f8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#b8e0f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='13' fill='#f0fbff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#b8e0f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Head snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='10' fill='#f8fdff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#b8e0f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Glow aura around snowman -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#a0e0ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes - glowing cyan -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='35' r='2' fill='#00ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='35' r='2' fill='#00ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Carrot nose - glowing orange -->
  <polygon points='50,39 50,41 57,40' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <polygon points='50,39 50,41 57,40' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc66' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Smile - glowing dots -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='43.5' r='1.2' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='43.5' r='1.2' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  
  <!-- Buttons on middle - glowing cyan -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#00ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#00ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='1.5' fill='#00ffe0'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf - bright red -->
  <path d='M40,45 Q50,49 60,45 L60,49 Q50,53 40,49 Z' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <path d='M58,46 Q62,50 60,58 L56,58 Q58,51 55,47 Z' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <path d='M40,45 Q50,49 60,45' fill='none' stroke='#ff7788' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf stripes -->
  <line x1='44' y1='46' x2='44' y2='49' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='47.5' x2='50' y2='51' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='46.5' x2='56' y2='49.5' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  
  <!-- Stick arms - glowing brown/amber -->
  <line x1='37' y1='52' x2='25' y2='44' stroke='#ddaa66' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='46' x2='22' y2='41' stroke='#ddaa66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='43' x2='24' y2='48' stroke='#ddaa66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <line x1='63' y1='52' x2='75' y2='44' stroke='#ddaa66' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='46' x2='78' y2='41' stroke='#ddaa66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='43' x2='76' y2='48' stroke='#ddaa66' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Little glow highlights -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.1'/>
  
  <!-- Snowflakes around -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='25' r='1.2' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='60' r='0.8' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='15' r='1' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='12' r='0.9' fill='#b0e8ff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
